two_M2_5_comparison.load_path: heads -> rear printed seats -> factory metal nuts; PCB follows REAR at opening. No FRONT/glass clamp.
two_M2_5_comparison.not_preferred_front_fixation: No separate FRONT-attached retainer designed; direct fixed FRONT stops fail the tested assembly path. Rear-fix candidate shown explicitly for comparison, not silently adopted.
two_M2_5_comparison.open_cover_risks: PCB/display move with REAR; support both halves, disengage native keys, prevent glass scraping frame, unplug actual leads without traction. Actual lead lengths/MX identities unknown.

USB_local.status: MANUFACTURING_RISK: two side ribs do not thicken the 0.88mm bottom web; no assumed strength qualification

four_latch_plan.single_pick_use: Enter the one 5.2x0.8mm local notch, slide to receiver window, push inward. Hand holds opened cover edge; then move pick to next hook.
four_latch_plan.limit: A 3mm LOCAL gap clears an already released hook; no proof the complete cover can flex to preserve all previous gaps sequentially. No simultaneous all-snaps-released claim. Physical latch/warp/tool-access coupon required.
